∀ (k : Type u_2) [inst : Field.{u_2} k] (p : Nat) [inst_1 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [inst_2 : CharP.{u_2} k p]
  [IsAlgClosed.{u_2} k] (M : Type u_3) [inst_4 : AddCommGroup.{u_3} M] [inst_5 : Module.{u_2, u_3} k M]
  [inst_6 :
    LieRingModule.{u_2, u_3} (Subtype.{u_2 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} (Etingof.Problem2_16_2.g.{u_2} k) x)
      M]
  [LieModule.{u_2, u_2, u_3} k
      (Subtype.{u_2 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} (Etingof.Problem2_16_2.g.{u_2} k) x) M]
  [FiniteDimensional.{u_2, u_3} k M]
  [LieModule.IsIrreducible.{u_2, u_2, u_3} k
      (Subtype.{u_2 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} (Etingof.Problem2_16_2.g.{u_2} k) x) M],
  Or
    (ExistsUnique.{u_2 + 1} fun μ =>
      Nonempty.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)}
        (LieModuleEquiv.{u_2, u_2, u_3, u_2} k
          (Subtype.{u_2 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} (Etingof.Problem2_16_2.g.{u_2} k) x) M
          (Etingof.Problem2_16_2.oneDimModule.{u_2} k μ)))
    (Exists.{u_2 + 1} fun γ =>
      Exists.{u_2 + 1} fun a =>
        And
          (Nonempty.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)}
            (LieModuleEquiv.{u_2, u_2, u_3, u_2} k
              (Subtype.{u_2 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} (Etingof.Problem2_16_2.g.{u_2} k) x) M
              (Etingof.Problem2_16_2.Fam.{u_2} k p γ a)))
          (∀ (γ' : Units.{u_2} k) (a' : k),
            Nonempty.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)}
                (LieModuleEquiv.{u_2, u_2, u_3, u_2} k
                  (Subtype.{u_2 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} (Etingof.Problem2_16_2.g.{u_2} k) x) M
                  (Etingof.Problem2_16_2.Fam.{u_2} k p γ' a')) →
              And (Eq.{u_2 + 1} γ' γ)
                (Exists.{1} fun n =>
                  Eq.{u_2 + 1} a'
                    (HAdd.hAdd.{u_2, u_2, u_2} a
                      (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, 1, u_2 + 1} (Etingof.Problem2_16_2.lam.{u_2} k p) n)))))
